title: Track who owns what
hints: Keep a `std::map<int, std::string>` of live objects (id to kind) and a counter for the last id; `create` increments the counter and inserts.
`destroy` erases the id and returns whether it was there. A `std::map` visits ids in ascending order, which is oldest first for the leak report.
lessonTitle: Memory Across the Boundary: Who Allocates, Who Frees
